title: I cannot stress what an absolutely...
text: I cannot stress what an absolutely wonderful time we had on this day trip. it was jaw droppingly stunning but really it was the tour company Mont Escape Tours that made this trip so fantastic. Our driver and tour guide, Ferran was WONDERFUL. He was very knowledgeable and showed us so many sites in and around the Pyrenees. 7 STAR EXPERIENCE!!!
author: Payal M

title: Great day out! Friendly and informative...
text: Great day out! Friendly and informative guide. The Pyrenees provides great scenery and a nice hike which is not too difficult if you are prepared for it. The old town has some great sights, and Vic was a nice stop for lunch. Would have liked some more guidance in restaurant choice tho : All in all an enjoyable day.
author: Benjamin O

title: Long day but some interesting sites
text: Unfortunately, in Quekalbs,all the restaurants had converted to their winter menus. So there was very little choice for food and it was VERY crowded.  Also, about 20 minutes after starting our hike, it began raining.  It just didn't turn out to be a good stop in our trip. Our stops in Vick and Nuria were very nice and enjoyable.   Our guide was very knowledgeable but, he just didn't know when to be quiet.  It was a none stop monologue from the time we checked in until we returned.  We probably had one hour out of the entire day of quiet.
author: PamR1548
